text.p: U.S. Electricar Inc Wednesday said it completed the previously announced sale of certain properties and assets of Industrial Electric Vehicles Inc to Legend Electric Vehicles Inc.

Legend Electric Vehicles is an entity established by former employees of U.S. Electricar Inc. Terms of the sale included assignment by the company to, and assumption by, Legend of a note obligation due previous owners from whom the company purchased the business three years ago. Further terms were not disclosed.

U.S. Electricar develops and manufactures electric vehicles for markets in the U.S. and internationally, with products ranging from converted sedans and light trucks to transit buses and other commercial vehicles.
